outcome: Prevalence of women with less than optimal weight gain during pregnancy
cohort: Singleton pregnant Japanese women who delivered at the study institute from 22 weeks' gestation during 2000-2002 and 2016-2018.
finding: There were no significant changes in the prevalence of underweight pregnant women or overall obstetric outcomes between the periods of 2000-2002 and 2016-2018 in singleton pregnant Japanese women, despite changes in maternal age distribution.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from two distinct periods: 2000-2002 and 2016-2018.
